title: Asteroids Survivor telemetry event
description: Updated 2026-09-16 for the wave-1 core loop increment (docs/Plans/2026-09-15-lets-deliver-next-increment.md). Supersedes the 2026-09-11 freeze. Every client event sent via navigator.sendBeacon() to VITE_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT MUST validate against this schema. No changes after 2026-09-16 without a new plan.

session_id.description: Opaque per-tab random id (UUID v4). Not a user id, not persisted across runs.

event_name.description: Closed set for the wave-1 retention probe.

properties.description: Event-scoped numeric/boolean/string facts only. No free text, no user-supplied content, no identifiers.

returning.description: session_start: true when IndexedDB already holds a previous run.

wave_number.description: wave_cleared: the wave number that was just cleared.

upgrade_id.description: upgrade_chosen: id of the upgrade the player claimed.

duration_ms.description: session_end: milliseconds survived on the run that just ended.

high_score_ms.description: session_end: best survived duration stored in IndexedDB.
